breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly retains the torsional shear stress τ in the plane stress analysis at the outer surface. It explicitly states 'Do not set τxy = 0 in part (c)' and uses τxy = τ (the value from part (b)) in the principal stress calculations. This directly contradicts and corrects the incomplete prompt's erroneous instruction to set torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, aligning with the ground truth which simply uses τxy = τ without any such incorrect zeroing instruction.
